x: Doug Whitehead, who was very promising last year in the Javelin and Shot, is now in the Forces and will probably have difficulty in getting along for matches. John Morrison should show improvement in the Shot.

The return match against the Whitgift Middle School was held on May 30th and a good crowd of our youngsters made the trip. Our only winner of the evening was John Morrison in the 440 yards. Wolton was second in the 880 and Hazel second in the mile.
Holtum, a new member was second with Johnny Morrison third. The 3 miles run was the main event on the programme with Jack Brown, the back marker off 60 yards and the limit man on 500.
We had three in the final of the 220 yards and John Morrison gained his Southern standard in the 440 yards. In addition we won the Southern Counties 4 x 110 yards relay.
Johnny Morrison and Doug Briggs together with " Mitch " eventually had to succumb to the calls of their country, but they are not forgotten.
